review.kind: self-review with targeted failure injection; not an independent review
invariants: Server-resolved scope, original store identity and exact request inputs bind command replay.
Conversation append, frozen plan and preparation linkage commit together; native publication and runtime settlement are atomic.
Stale leases, newer messages, stops, changed context and competing draft edits cannot publish an old preparation.
Exact review binds payload, media, origin, profile and both current platform actor generations.
Approval expiry, revocation, role changes and media changes block cached export receipts.
UI and typed tools share native commands; typed tools expose neither human approval nor export.
Reads and construction create no local actor authority; explicit local submission alone initializes defaults and never resets administration.
Existing postal and sequence rejection/recovery semantics remain covered.

limits: Control and workflow evidence, not live model capability or campaign performance.
Authored synthetic context, four fictional placements and five bundled synthetic media files only.
libSQL proof uses the local Hrana simulator, not a hosted Turso probe.
Local comparison previews work but collect no viewer observations; full viewer and learning parity follow in #133.
No live provider verification, deployment, ad purchase, source-history import or public cutover.
One trusted local workspace and supported worker topology; hosted identity/context and live inference remain platform work.
